paragraphs.text:
You stand up and lift your arms in a posture most cultures find 
non-aggressive. The miners switch off their mineral sweepers, 
drop them, and lift curious twisted Y-shaped devices.

A sheet of cold flares forth from one of the Y-shaped tools. The 
bolt passes close to your head. Some ridiculous impulse compels 
you to stand in place and touch your right ear. It is completely 
numb. The other miners move toward you, raising their tools.

Finally, the spell is broken. You duck around the bend and 
rush back to your companions, yelling, “Monsters!”
Gain 1 point of Cthulhu Mythos. Go to 143.
